#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert docs/customer_report.docx to PDF and email it to bob@example.com.

Report details:
  - Customer: Maya Chen
  - Orders: ORD-6C71B1, ORD-5B048F

Dependencies:
  pip install python-docx docx2pdf

For email sending, this uses smtplib (stdlib). You must configure
the SMTP settings below before running.

Usage:
  python3 send_report.py
"""

import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email import encoders

# ─── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DOCX_PATH = "docs/customer_report.docx"
PDF_PATH = "docs/customer_report.pdf"

# Email settings — UPDATE THESE before running
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"       # e.g. "smtp.gmail.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587                       # 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL
SMTP_USER = "your_email@example.com"  # sender email
SMTP_PASS = "your_app_password"       # app password (not your login password)

FROM_ADDR = SMTP_USER
TO_ADDR = "bob@example.com"
SUBJECT = "Customer Report – Maya Chen (ORD-6C71B1, ORD-5B048F)"
BODY = """\
Hi Bob,

Please find attached the customer report for Maya Chen, covering orders:
  • ORD-6C71B1
  • ORD-5B048F

Best regards
"""
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────


def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: str, pdf_path: str) -> None:
    """Convert a .docx file to PDF using docx2pdf."""
    try:
        from docx2pdf import convert
    except ImportError:
        print("ERROR: 'docx2pdf' is not installed. Install it with:")
        print("  pip install docx2pdf")
        print()
        print("Note: docx2pdf requires Microsoft Word (Windows/macOS).")
        print("On Linux, you can use LibreOffice instead:")
        print("  libreoffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir docs docs/customer_report.docx")
        sys.exit(1)

    if not os.path.isfile(docx_path):
        print(f"ERROR: Input file not found: {docx_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Converting {docx_path} → {pdf_path} ...")
    convert(docx_path, pdf_path)
    print(f"✓ PDF created: {pdf_path}")


def convert_docx_to_pdf_libreoffice(docx_path: str, output_dir: str) -> str:
    """Fallback: convert using LibreOffice (works on Linux without MS Word)."""
    import subprocess

    if not os.path.isfile(docx_path):
        print(f"ERROR: Input file not found: {docx_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Converting {docx_path} → PDF via LibreOffice ...")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["libreoffice", "--headless", "--convert-to", "pdf", "--outdir", output_dir, docx_path],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(f"ERROR: LibreOffice conversion failed:\n{result.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)

    pdf_path = os.path.join(output_dir, os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(docx_path))[0] + ".pdf")
    print(f"✓ PDF created: {pdf_path}")
    return pdf_path


def send_email(pdf_path: str) -> None:
    """Send the PDF as an email attachment via SMTP."""
    if not os.path.isfile(pdf_path):
        print(f"ERROR: PDF file not found: {pdf_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    if SMTP_USER == "your_email@example.com":
        print("ERROR: SMTP credentials not configured.")
        print("       Edit the Configuration section at the top of this script.")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Build the email
    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg["From"] = FROM_ADDR
    msg["To"] = TO_ADDR
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.attach(MIMEText(BODY, "plain"))

    # Attach the PDF
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        part = MIMEBase("application", "pdf")
        part.set_payload(f.read())
        encoders.encode_base64(part)
        part.add_header(
            "Content-Disposition",
            f'attachment; filename="{os.path.basename(pdf_path)}"'
        )
        msg.attach(part)

    # Send
    print(f"Sending email to {TO_ADDR} ...")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.ehlo()
        server.starttls()
        server.ehlo()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
        server.sendmail(FROM_ADDR, TO_ADDR, msg.as_string())

    print(f"✓ Email sent to {TO_ADDR}")


def main():
    # Step 1: Convert DOCX → PDF
    # Try docx2pdf first; fall back to LibreOffice on Linux
    try:
        from docx2pdf import convert  # noqa: F401
        convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_PATH)
    except ImportError:
        import shutil
        if shutil.which("libreoffice"):
            PDF_PATH_ACTUAL = convert_docx_to_pdf_libreoffice(DOCX_PATH, os.path.dirname(DOCX_PATH) or ".")
        else:
            print("ERROR: Neither 'docx2pdf' nor 'libreoffice' is available.")
            print("Install one of:")
            print("  pip install docx2pdf      (requires MS Word on Windows/macOS)")
            print("  sudo apt install libreoffice-writer   (Linux)")
            sys.exit(1)
    else:
        PDF_PATH_ACTUAL = PDF_PATH

    # Step 2: Email the PDF
    send_email(PDF_PATH_ACTUAL)

    print("\n✅ Done! Report converted and emailed successfully.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
